raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when WebSurfer identified Susa as the first place mentioned in the Book of Esther (New International Version) without verifying if it was indeed the correct interpretation of the biblical text. The first place mentioned in the Book of Esther is actually "India," not Susa. This incorrect identification of the location led to the subsequent misdirection of the research toward Iran and its Prime Minister in April 1977, instead of focusing on India and its Prime Minister, Morarji Desai.
